Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the ACME infra team would like to follow up with a focused architecture deep-dive to validate network, SSO, and MTLS expectations before we move to procurement.

High-level asks for the session:
- Walk through network topology and firewall/NAT requirements (we have a corporate proxy)
- Authentication and SSO flows (SAML/OIDC; audit log retention)
- Deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and data residency implications
- Expected latencies for typical request patterns (50–500 tokens) and scaling behavior

We can do a 60–75 minute session. Proposed slots (PT):
- Thu Nov 19, 10:00–11:15
- Thu Nov 19, 14:00–15:15
- Fri Nov 20, 09:30–10:45

If those won't work, happy to take a calendar invite with alternative times. Also: could you share any pre-reads (slides + diagrams) so our SREs can prep questions?

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Martin
Sr. Platform Architect, Acme Corp

Hi Elena — great to hear you want to do a deep-dive. Any of the Thu Nov 19 slots work for us; let’s tentatively hold Thu 11/19 14:00–15:15 PT. I’ll send a calendar invite once we confirm.

I’ve attached a short runbook and an annotated network diagram to help your SREs prep. Draft agenda below (60–75 min):

1) 5 min — Introductions and goals (Priyom / Elena)
2) 15 min — High-level deployment options & tradeoffs (Laura)
3) 20 min — Network & security deep-dive (Jonas)
4) 10 min — SSO / audit logging & compliance notes (Rishi)
5) 10–20 min — Q&A + follow-ups / next steps (All)

Pre-reads (short):
- redwood-design-runbook-v1.pdf (attached) — 6 pages, includes SLOs, operating assumptions
- acme-network-diagram-annotated.png (attached) — proposed placement options and ports
- Confluence: ACME Design Runbook (link below) — internal runbook with SSO/retention examples

Are there any specific diagrams or test scenarios your team wants us to include in the session? If so, reply here and we’ll update the materials before the meeting.

I’ll coordinate internal owners for each agenda item (see internal note below).

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference

- Laura: attach a 1-slide bench summary (PDF) to the runbook (action: laura)
- Jonas: export a higher-res network diagram and highlight required outbound ports (action: jonas)
- Rishi: draft a short list of questions we should ask ACME about their logging/KMS requirements (action: rishi)

I’ll collate updates and send the final pre-read set by 09:00 PT on 11/19.

— Priyom
